To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have constructed a yeast contig encompassing USH1C.
we have constructed a YAC contigr spanning approximately 4 cMr of the chromosome 11p region that contains the Usher syndrome Type 1C and Familial hyperinsulinism genetic loci.
we have constructed a YAC contigr that encompasses the critical regions of the USH1C (chromosome 11p14.3) and HI (chromosome 119p14.3-p15) loci and spans an estimated 4 cM.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of a YAC map encompassing two loci that have been assigned to 11p14.2-p15.1: USH1C (Usher syndrome, type 1C) and HI (familial hyperinsulinism).
the construction of physical maps of human chromosomes.
the construction of physical maps of human chromosomal regions, with a focus on the identification and characterization of disease genes and their associated mutations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the contig encompasses the USH1C critical region, but does not encompass the critical region for HI.
the USH1C locus is located within the D11S1310-D11S419 interval.

this YAC contig is the first to be established for the D11S419- D11S1310 interval and that it provides the foundation for the construction of a physical map for the D11 S926- D11S899 interval and for identification of gene loci associated with USH and HI. 2.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have constructed a contig of 28 YACs spanning an estimated genetic distance 4 cM on 11p14.2-15.1.
we have generated an integrated map of the USH1C-HI region, which is the first step in the positional cloning strategy for identification of the USHIC gene.

a minimal contig of six YACs spanning the USH1C locus and the HI locus on chromosome 11 has been constructed, with another 24 YACs confirming their position and order on the contig, which is the first contig for USH1C.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the contig is a resource for the identification of the genes responsible for USH1C.
the YACs were used in a very effective manner in constructing a physical contig that spans the region containing the USH1C locus.
YAC contig maps are a powerful tool for identifying disease-causing genes.
